key_insight: Region-aware Mixture of Experts forcing models achieve compressor-flow accuracy similar to data assimilation without requiring experimental inputs during deployment.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a route to more accurate axial-compressor CFD by learning corrections to baseline turbulence-model predictions.
method: Fuse experimental PIV data with fixed-grid steady RANS and moving-grid hybrid RANS/LES using a Multi-Fidelity Ensemble Kalman Filter.
Train neural networks on the enriched database to map local velocity, velocity gradients and turbulent viscosity to discrete Navier–Stokes forcing terms.
Use a Mixture of Experts to combine learned corrections for different flow regions.
evidence_signal: In the reported compressor assessment, Mixture of Experts discrepancies from experimental data were systematically lower than baseline RANS and very similar to MFEnKF results.
watch_item: Individual neural models produced localized errors near blade tips exceeding baseline RANS; generalization beyond the assessed compressor flow remains unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Assisted Turbulence Modeling via Data Assimilation and Machine Learning for Turbomachinery Flows
